info.title: health
info.description: A private, configurable health and wellbeing journal for tracking personal metrics, habits, goals, and trends.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's Health configuration
get.description: Returns profile, metric, and integration preferences scoped to the authenticated user.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

put.summary: Update the authenticated user's Health configuration
put.description: Updates supplied profile and metric fields while retaining omitted fields.

profile.description: Profile fields; null values clear optional fields.

metrics.description: Metric preferences keyed by stable metric identifier.

searchDailyNotes.description: Whether this user's Daily Notes are included in Nextcloud Unified Search.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.description: Returns only entries owned by the authenticated user, ordered by `recordedAt DESC, id DESC`. Time filters use half-open `[from, to)` semantics.

parameters.name: metricKey
parameters.description: Optional stable metric identifier.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional inclusive RFC3339 lower bound for `recordedAt`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional exclusive RFC3339 upper bound for `recordedAt`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: A filter, limit, timestamp, or cursor is invalid.

401.description: Current user is not logged in

recordedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit timezone or offset.

note.description: Optional plain-text journal note of at most 1000 characters.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's active and paused goals and the supported target registry
get.description: Retired goal identities remain available internally for historical progress but are excluded from goal management.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Goals and supported target definitions returned

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.description: A user can have one logical goal for each target and period. Its first revision becomes effective in the current local period.

targetKey.description: Stable target identifier from the Goal Target registry.

period.description: Goal period supported by that target.

comparator.description: Goal direction. `gte` means at least; `lte` means at most, at or below.

remindersEnabled.description: Whether deterministic Gentle reminders are enabled.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The target, period, direction, or value is unsupported.

401.description: Current user is not logged in

put.summary: Update a logical goal or its current local-period revision
put.description: Editing target value or direction does not rewrite older periods. Changing target or period retires the old identity and creates the new identity.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Goal ID.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

404.description: The goal is missing or belongs to another user.

401.description: Current user is not logged in

delete.summary: Retire a goal without deleting its historical revisions or past progress

get.summary: Evaluate all goals in one requested local period
get.description: Boundaries are resolved in the authenticated user's Nextcloud timezone. Progress is derived from entries, measurements, and daily values; it is never persisted.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Requested goal period.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD date selecting a day, week, or month. Omit for `long_term`.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The period or date is invalid or in the future.

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: List day-level descriptive statistics for selected metrics
get.description: Period bounds are resolved in the authenticated user's Nextcloud timezone. The response contains canonical values only, with every local date in the half-open `[from, to)` range represented in each selected metric series.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period preset. Defaults to `last_30_days`.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated stable metric keys. Omit to use currently enabled journal metrics; provide an empty string for no metrics.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The period or metric selection is invalid.

401.description: Current user is not logged in
